svg.title: Cloud-OpsBench — all-six coverage by family
svg.desc: 754 cases across 12 families. 11 families fully JRA; all-six full 722/754. Bars show cases with CA/FA/JRA/MC/EOC/ECR all at 1.0 over total cases.

svg.text: 11 of 12 families fully JRA; the only JRA miss is trainticket/performance/34. Remaining bars are process-only residuals.
